question: Does cold brew contain less acid than hot drip coffee?

sources.title: Acidity in brewed coffee (synthetic test source)

paragraphs.heading: Extraction method
paragraphs.text: Cold brew steeps ground coffee in room-temperature water for twelve to twenty hours, while hot drip passes water through the bed in minutes.

paragraphs.heading: Acidity measurements
paragraphs.text: In the same controlled trial, cold brew measured pH 5.6 and hot drip measured pH 4.9, so cold brew was less acidic.

paragraphs.heading: Panel results
paragraphs.text: A trained panel described cold brew as smoother with lower perceived acidity than hot drip in blinded tasting.

paragraphs.heading: Compound profile
paragraphs.text: Chlorogenic acid lactones increase with heat, which is one reason hot drip tastes more acidic than cold brew.

claims.text: Cold brew is measurably less acidic than hot drip coffee.
